This is the same tutorial the Tutorial button runs inside the app, written out to read in one go. The guided version highlights each control and plays the result, which is worth doing at least once: the whole point of Chord Lab is what you hear and what it measures. Open OWL ↗

    Written once, read twice: these steps are one list of records in dist/js/tutorial.js. The tour walks them and this page renders them, so the two cannot disagree, and a test checks that every control they point at still exists.
